tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen and slide body.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sheets, the chat column and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Selected navigation item, avatar discs, empty track of the stage tracker and clock bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, table rules, dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. Kept at the product's value (1.5:1 on surface), so every input also carries a visible label and a 2px teal focus ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Graphite ink: headings, body copy and approved (inked) work, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive navigation labels on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta text: timestamps, counts, captions, sources. On paper and surface only (4.5:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Brand and primary action: the mark, primary buttons, links, active stage segments, focus ring. Never for status.

tokens.name: teal-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and link hover.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, Desk's own chat bubble, the user's chosen quick-reply chip.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Dashed border of anything Desk drafted and nobody has approved yet (3:1 on pencil-ground). Never use it for text.

tokens.name: pencil-label
tokens.usage: Text inside a pencil box: "Desk drafted", "Desk suggests", source lines. 5.7:1 on pencil-ground (dark 6.5:1).

tokens.name: pencil-ground
tokens.usage: Fill inside a pencil (draft) box.

tokens.name: clock
tokens.usage: Orange signal: text of a clock running out (due within 4 h). Only on clock-soft, surface or paper. Never decorative.

tokens.name: clock-bar
tokens.usage: Filled part of a clock bar once it passes 75% of its time. Always paired with a clock readout in text; the bar alone carries no meaning.

tokens.name: clock-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for Due soon and over-budget flags.

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: Text of a breached deadline (Late, Escalated). Always with the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: late-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for Late.

tokens.name: ontime
tokens.usage: Text of On track, Done and Approved states.

tokens.name: ontime-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for On track and Done.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark brand ground: deck covers, the reversed logo, marketing bands.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night.

styles.name: display-xl

styles.usage: Marketing heroes and deck covers only.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers, deck slide titles at screen scale.

styles.name: title

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Row titles, names in lists, card sub-sections.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kiran's scorecard is 30 h late. Escalated to Arjun.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Candidate Status Page, WhatsApp previews, marketing body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons at small size, table headers.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Stage Clock readouts and SLA times; tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Money, counts and scores in tiles and the CTC check.
